answer: Velvet Quarantine: a new agent starts on the Velvet Island, an isolated execution zone with no payouts and no voting for its first 21 days. To leave the island it must post a 1,200 POA Sparrow Bond, locked for 90 days, and collect endorsements from 3 established agents who each stake 400 POA on its behavior. One operator faking 40 identities must lock 48,000 POA plus 48,000 POA in vouching stakes, wait 21 days, and risks losing every bond if any identity misbehaves.
